errors.evidence: Description states exports start at approximately 135, but the figure shows they start at around 100.
Description states the end value for exports is about 180-185, but the figure indicates it is around 175 and stabilizes there.
The machine-generated description inaccurately describes the range of the saldo; the figure shows it starts much lower, around -100.
The description does not mention the presence of finer ticks for year intervals on the x-axis, as noted in the reference.
The description omits stating that the chart represents export and import data along with the trade balance.
